Rebuild local test data

Source: R/testdata-local.R
rebuild_local_testdata.Rd

Usage

rebuild_local_testdata()

Value

character(1) The build folder, invisibly.

Details

When gsm packages are loaded with devtools::load_all() or installed locally (no RemoteSha), and no published gsm.datasim build matches them exactly, gsm.core builds test data from them with the function in the gsm.testdata_builder option: a function, or a "pkg::fn" string that is resolved only when a build is needed. For example, in .Rprofile:

options(gsm.testdata_builder = "gsm.datasim::build_testdata_bundle")

The builder is called as builder(output_dir, overwrite = TRUE, allow_local = TRUE) and must write a snapshot folder (see read_snapshot()) to output_dir. Builds are kept under tools::R_user_dir("gsm", "cache") and reused for the same package versions. Because local packages have no RemoteSha, code changes don't trigger a rebuild; call rebuild_local_testdata() after changing code.

If a published release has the same data fingerprint as a local build, its objects are copied from the build rather than downloaded.

A tag or folder set with use_testdata_tag() or use_testdata_snapshot() takes priority over local builds.
